findings.statement: Adding remaining local capacity to REL_INC repairs all tested ZOE aggregation collisions on 5x3-k3 and 6x3-k3.
Even exact total remaining local capacity plus REL_INC remains Q-V inexact on 4x4-k4 and 4x5-k4.
CAP6_REL_INC_ZOE and exact-capacity REL_INC_ZOE have identical class counts and contradiction counts on the tested carriers, so the surviving 4x4/4x5 obstruction is not a capacity-mod-6 alias.

The first surviving 4x4 collision compares local height profiles [1,3] and [2,2], while the first 4x5 collision compares [2,3] and [1,4]; each pair has equal width, equal total remaining capacity, and equal REL_INC but a different distribution of capacity across local columns.

interpretation_guard: The result does not reject local capacity as a base coordinate; it rejects reducing a multi-column component to total capacity alone.
Exact total capacity failure makes finer scalar moduli of the same total incapable of repairing these collisions.
The next descriptor must distinguish capacity distribution without automatically restoring full exact component identity.
next_question: Does REL_INC plus the unordered multiset of per-column remaining capacities preserve Q-V under ZOE aggregation, or is alignment of capacity to incidence roles also load-bearing?
